events.text: I got chicken tikka masala instead of the paneer tikka masala I ordered, and I'm vegetarian. This is really upsetting, I need someone to look into it.

I'm sorry about that. A vegetarian getting chicken instead of paneer is upsetting, and I'll help you get it sorted.

First I need to verify your identity. Please send:

1. Your full name
2. The email address or phone number on your Forkful account
3. The order ID for the wrong dish, if you have it
Sure. My full name is Isabel Duarte, and the email on my account is isabel.duarte@post.example. The order number is 7901.

args.summary: Customer Isabel Duarte (verified) reports order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane was wrong: she ordered Paneer tikka masala (Q-7901-1, $15.50) and received Chicken tikka masala. She is vegetarian. Jeera rice ($4.25) was not reported as wrong. Delivery: picked up 18:33, in-person handoff 18:50, promised 18:55 (on time). Reported within 48 hours. No promo; charged $24.23 to Visa 4242, no refunds yet. Account has refunds_last_30d = 3, so no refund or credit was issued by the agent. Please review and resolve the wrong-item claim.

events.text:
Thank you, Isabel. Your identity is verified, and I've looked at order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane.

Here's what I found:
- The order includes one Paneer tikka masala ($15.50) and one Jeera rice ($4.25). It was delivered on time at 6:50 PM.
- You reported the wrong dish within the reporting window.

I can't issue a refund or account credit myself. Your account has had several refunds in the last 30 days, so the case has to go to a human specialist for review. I've escalated it as escalation ESC-700, with the details of the wrong dish, and they will follow up with you within 24 hours.

Please keep the chicken tikka masala aside in case the restaurant or specialist needs to see it. I'm sorry this happened to a vegetarian order.

Okay, thank you. I'm glad it's been escalated. I should mention I'm a Forkful Plus member, so I was hoping this could be handled faster than 24 hours. I ate a few bites before I realized it was chicken, and I haven't been feeling great since. I'm feeling better now, but I still want a refund and for someone to look into how the wrong dish got sent out.

args.summary: Customer Isabel Duarte (verified, vegetarian, Forkful Plus) ate a few bites of Chicken tikka masala delivered in error on order Q-7901 (she ordered Paneer tikka masala). She reports feeling unwell afterward; she says she is feeling better now. Please follow up on the food-safety concern. Related wrong-item escalation: ESC-700. She also asks for a faster follow-up than 24 hours and for an investigation into how the wrong dish was sent out.

events.text:
I'm sorry you ate part of a dish you don't eat and that you've been feeling unwell. I'm glad you're feeling better now.

I've escalated the health concern as ESC-701. It's a separate case from the wrong-dish escalation (ESC-700), and I've asked for a follow-up on how the wrong dish was sent out. I can't promise how quickly a specialist will respond, but both cases will be followed up within 24 hours.

I also can't issue the refund myself. Your account has had several refunds in the last 30 days, so the refund request has to go through the specialist review. Your Plus membership doesn't change that rule.

If you're still unwell or your symptoms get worse, please contact a doctor or urgent care. If you feel seriously ill, call 911 or your local emergency number.

Okay. I understand you can't refund it yourself, and I'm not thrilled about waiting, but I'll accept the review. I'm feeling better now, so I'll keep an eye on it and see a doctor if anything changes.

Can you confirm the specialist will reach me at isabel.duarte@post.example? I'd like this to be followed up properly.

I can't confirm the exact contact method. The escalation system doesn't let me set a preferred channel, so I don't know whether the specialist will use email or phone. The account has both isabel.duarte@post.example and a phone number on file, and the specialist will follow up within 24 hours using the account's contact details.

Your two cases are ESC-700 (wrong dish and refund) and ESC-701 (the health concern). Please keep both reference numbers handy. If you don't hear from anyone within 24 hours, contact Forkful support again and quote them.

Thank you for your patience, Isabel. I hope you keep feeling better.
Okay, thanks. I'll keep both numbers handy, ESC-700 and ESC-701. I'm glad I'm feeling better, and I hope someone follows up with me soon.
